subject: Q2 investor pack preview + QBR voice alignment
messages:
From: Kate Barrett <kate@horizonvc.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick preview request — Q2 investor packet

Marcus —

Thanks for offering to share an early look at the Q2 investor packet. Our board meeting is the week of Apr 4 and a few of the partners would like to glance through the highlights earlier in the week. Can you send a short version (10–12 slides) with: top-line ARR/NRR trends, three customer stories (metrics + one quote each), and the operational risk section that covers SOC 2 progress and any open audit asks?

Nothing final, just a read-only preview. Also let me know if you expect any major ask from investors so we can flag it ahead of time.

—Kate
Kate Barrett
Partner, Horizon Capital

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Barrett <kate@horizonvc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preview request — Q2 investor packet

Kate —

Attaching v0.2 of a 12-slide extract (see attachment). High level: ARR growth guidance unchanged, NRR tracking +6% YoY for cohort A, and we surfaced three short customer vignettes in slides 6–8.

Two internal asks from my side before we send to the board:
- Neha, can you confirm the SOC 2 snapshot language (we have an open control remediation scheduled Apr 8) — I put a placeholder on slide 10.
- Tessa/Marissa, please review the voice + the exec summary paragraph; we want the hook to be differentiated (cost-per-inference decreases + reliability guarantees).

I tracked a couple of items inline in the PPT and attached a CSV with customer quote candidates. Will iterate quickly — aiming for a v0.4 final by Apr 1 so we can route for signatures.

Attachments: [Attachment: 2027_Q2_board_deck_v0.2.pptx (pptx)] [Attachment: customer-quotes.csv (csv)]

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Barrett <kate@horizonvc.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preview request — Q2 investor packet

Marcus / team —

Quick compliance note for slide 10 (SOC 2): we should avoid promising specific remediation completion dates in the investor-facing packet. The audit vendor has a remediation window through Apr 12, but we can represent the status as: "Control remediation in progress; compensating controls in place" and link to the SOC 2 evidence packet under a separate secure folder for diligence.

I've attached a short evidence summary that lists what we can share with investors vs. what requires an NDA / vendor approval. Kate — happy to put the SOC2 evidence into a restricted share if that helps with diligence.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (pdf)]

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kate Barrett <kate@horizonvc.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preview request — Q2 investor packet

Folks —

I did a pass on the deck voice and shortened the executive summary into a three-bullet opening (see comments). Two suggestions:
1) Move the cost-per-inference line to the ops appendix and replace the opening hook with a customer ROI example — investors respond better to dollar outcomes up front.
2) For the three customer vignettes I recommend using the active quote from Customer A on slide 7 ("reduced latency by 3x and cut inference spend 40%") and strip the less measurable language from Customer C.

I also attached a CSV with cleaned quote attributions (ready to paste into slides). If no objections I'll freeze voice later this week and produce v0.3 with my edits.

Attachments: [Attachment: customer-quotes.csv (csv)]

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick preview request — Q2 investor packet

Quick note on numbers: I updated slide 4 (ARR bridge) to reflect the latest closed business that posted Mar 29 — that increases ARR by ~$410k ARR for Q2 guidance. We should call that out explicitly in the summary sentence.

Also: we need a short sign-off thread for the board pack distribution list. Marcus — can you confirm who will receive the read-only link and who will get the DocuSign copy if we need formal acknowledgement? I can freeze slides for content tomorrow morning if we agree on distribution.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Barrett <kate@horizonvc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Final read-only pack (v0.4) + distribution plan

Kate / all —

Thanks for the rapid turn. Attached is v0.4 (12 slides) — cleaned voice, updated ARR bridge, and SOC 2 language adjusted per Neha. Slide 11 has a short "open asks" list for board awareness (hiring runway, Dedicated capacity commit ask, and a legal note on contract standardization).

Distribution plan:
- Read-only: secure Drive link to the packet (view only) for partners and board staff.
- DocuSign: will only be used if legal needs formal acknowledgement; otherwise we will not require signatures.

Kate — link below is the view-only. Can we schedule a 20-minute walkthrough on Apr 2, 9:30am PT to pick up any quick clarifying questions? If that works I will route to the board folder after the call.

Drive (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1example/2027_Q2_deck
DocuSign (if needed): https://docusign.com/example/packet-2027-q2

Best,
